Verified in a real Chromium browser via the isolated E2E stack (e2e/flows/97-terminal-preview-banner-height-cap.spec.ts): created a task with a 5300-char description + actionId=new-iterate (mirrors the real trg-c57bec15 production report), clicked the real Launch CTA, and asserted the terminal canvas keeps a nonzero height and the preview banner clears (dispatch succeeds) rather than staying stuck. Verified LOAD-BEARING by running the identical spec against the pre-fix code first: FAILED (canvas reported hidden — height 0, matching the reported user-visible symptom exactly), via an explicit git stash of the fix and restore.
